BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_GIRL_IN_MAZE_EVENT.page:
You step into an ashen maze of corridors that seems to stretch on forever.
The path is silent and unchanging, its repeating passages lost beyond sight. As you walk alone, a strange melancholy settles over you, followed by a dreamlike haze.
You pause and glance behind you.
A slender figure flashes through the depths of the corridor. You give chase and find a golden-haired girl before a mirror, mourning something you cannot see. The dim lamp overhead goes dark. When it flickers back to life, the girl is gone. Only a hand mirror remains on the floor.
You pick up the hand mirror from the floor. The dim lamp goes out again. When you see light once more, you have already arrived somewhere unknown.

You lift your foot and bring it down hard on the hand mirror. The mirror shatters, and flying fragments cut your skin. As the mirror breaks, the maze begins to collapse, and you return to the moment before you entered it...
You do nothing and silently walk deeper into the maze...
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_CLOWN_EVENT.title: Clown
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_CLOWN_EVENT.pages.INITI:
He slips between light and shadow, concealing every trace of his presence. One moment he cowers before you; the next, he is laughing behind your back. Each time you turn to face him, he has already vanished.
He toys with you through illusion after illusion, his frenzied laughter echoing without end. Every strike finds empty air. Your nerves draw tighter with each miss.
Then, without warning, he stops. The mad grin remains, his eyes fever-bright and uncanny. He produces three objects and juggles them idly, as though offering them for sale.
You choose a hand mirror. When you take it in your hand, the clown suddenly disappears. You are somewhat confused, but you continue on with the mirror.
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_WAX_STATUE_EVENT.title: Wax Dolls
On your journey, you encounter a pair of wax dolls. A whisper reaches you: "We were born as twins. Please do not separate us." You decide...
Take both wax dolls. Obtain Twin Wax Doll.
Take one wax doll. Obtain Lonely Wax Doll.
Whatever you chose, the wax dolls do not move. Dolls are only dolls, after all.
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_BIRD_SINGER_EVENT.title: Bird Singer
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_BIRD_SINGER_EVENT.pages: In the bug-infested Spire, you see a strange half-bird creature talking to herself: "I wonder if my song works on them." Your instincts tell you the entire Act will be affected by her song. Monsters at affected nodes will begin combat at half HP. You decide...
Lose 10 HP and mark nodes affected by the song.
Wait and see. Requires more than 10 HP.
Affected nodes will not be marked.
Her song strikes your mind like a heavy blow. When you recover, the mysterious creature is gone.
Driven by instinct, you leave. A chilling sound seems to come from behind you. At least you were not caught in it.
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_HORRIFYING_GLUTTON_EVEN:
In the bug-infested Spire, you find a strange half-beast creature crouched over the corpse of an insect.
"Not enough! Not enough!" She notices you and complains, "Go find me something tasty."
Choose an Attack card. [gold]Enchant[/gold] it with Feeding.
Help her hunt. Requires an enchantable Attack card.
Spend [gold]{Gold}[/gold] Gold to obtain a common or uncommon relic.
Oh, delicious♪ In return, I'll teach you how to hunt.
Oh, delicious♪ In return, choose something from my treasure.
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_QUEEN_TART_EVENT.title: Queen's Tart
Perhaps you have climbed the Spire for too long and your mind is failing. You see a tart with legs. Before you can decide whether this is a dream, the tart walks up to you, kneels, and pleads:
"Please eat me now. As long as I am not offered to the wicked Queen of Hearts, you may do whatever you like with me."
Obtain [gold]Queen's Tart[/gold] and unlock a special event.
You did not expect food in the Spire to taste this good.
You decide to keep the tart and present it to the Queen of Hearts.
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_QUEEN_OF_HEARTS_EVENT.p:
You see three bizarre knights made of playing cards, and the queen, or something resembling one, they guard. The queen seems to smell the tart on you.
"Have you brought me a gift? Excellent. I shall grant you a knighthood."
Choose up to [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards. Give each a random Suit enchantment.
Go, and take more heads for me.
You like playing cards? You have excellent taste.
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_PLAYING_CARD_GARDENERS_: Several playing-card gardeners frantically paint white roses red. When they notice the deck in your hands, they stop at once, as though they have found a far larger flowerbed.
Spend [gold]{Gold}[/gold] Gold. Turn every non-Hearts Suit into Hearts, preserving its rank and used triggers.
A random enchantable card gains Hearts with a random number of stacks.
Help paint the roses. Requires an enchantable card.
The gardeners carefully paint every card red. White roses, Diamonds, Clubs, and Spades now all look like Hearts.
You help them finish a bed of roses. As you leave, one gardener slips a red-stained card into your deck.
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_HEART_JACK_EVENT.title: Jack of Hearts
A Jack of Hearts slips quietly from your deck. With his long paper arms, he shelters a trembling tart and points down a path leading away from the Queen's castle.
Obtain [gold]Jack of Hearts[/gold]. Your next shop purchase is free.
The Jack leads the tart into the roses. Before leaving, he places his card in your palm.
A sharp paper edge cuts across your hand. The Jack silently lowers the tart, leaving you with a gift fit for the Queen.
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_GENTLE_GIFT_EVENT.title: Gentle Gift
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_GENTLE_GIFT_EVENT.pages: You see a strange half-dragon creature. A faintly dangerous aura surrounds her. "So there are other visitors in this Spire." She smiles at you. "Would you like to build a snowman with your big sister?"
A random card gains Evil Qi. If it already has an enchantment, that enchantment is replaced.
Refuse. Requires a card that can receive Evil Qi.
When you finish, she hands you a cute little ornament. "A gift for you."
She does not seem surprised, only smiles softly. "Then I hope your wish comes true." You feel a strange power cling to you.
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_FRIENDLY_SLIME_EVENT.pa: You see a humanoid slime. Strange sounds come from her body, but oddly, you feel no hostility. "Tekeli-li! Are you an actor in this play?! Are you here to be my friend?!" she greets you in an overly cheerful voice.
Nod hello. Requires 1 enchantable Attack or Skill card.
Shake her hand. Obtain Friendly Slime.
Take [red]{HandshakeDamage}[/red] damage. Choose 2 Attack or Skill cards to enchant with Dissolve.
Shake her hand. Requires 2 enchantable Attack or Skill cards and enough HP.
Take [red]{HugDamage}[/red] damage. Choose 3 Attack or Skill cards to enchant with Dissolve.
Hug her. Requires 3 enchantable Attack or Skill cards and enough HP.
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_FRIENDLY_SLIME_EVENT.se: Choose cards to enchant with Dissolve.
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_FRIENDLY_SLIME_EVENT.pa: "Hehe, I finally have a role? I get to be the heroine in a pretty dress!" The slime sways happily, and some of her body seems to cling to you.
A sharp pain shoots through you. Her body is made of acid. "Did I hurt you? Sorry! This is the King's power. I can't help it." Her acid seems to change your body.
Pain courses through your whole body. Her body is made of acid. "Did I hurt you? Sorry! This is the King's power. I can't help it." Her acid seems to change your body.
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_ENDLESS_TEA_PARTY_EVENT: In a clearing, you find a strange trio holding a tea party. Monsters could appear at any moment, yet they carry on without a care. They must be mad. As you approach, the Hatter calls out: "Try this one! Why is a raven like a writing desk?"
"The answer is, umm, Miss Hatter has absolutely no idea! So, would you like some black tea? Or would you like to buy a hat?"
The black tea has a strange sweetness. By the time you finish it, the tea party has vanished.
The Hatter happily accepts your Gold and stuffs a deeply suspicious hat into your hands. In the next moment, the tea party vanishes.
You rest briefly beside the tea party. When you wake, the tea party has vanished.
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_LAST_WHITE_KNIGHT_EVENT:
After battle upon battle, you are exhausted. Yet your warrior's instinct senses killing intent ahead. It is a strange enemy: a red knight chess piece.
"Check!" the Red Knight declares coldly.
"Check!" another voice comes from behind you. It is a white knight chess piece. "Sir, please allow me to face the Red Knight. Those are the rules of the game."
Until the next rest site, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold] at the start of combat.
Fight a random elite from this act and obtain [gold]Knight Chess Piece[/gold].
Ignore both knights and go on alone.
The White Knight bows slightly, then charges toward the Red Knight. You continue onward as crisp sounds of clashing chess pieces echo behind you.
You ignore the game. After a moment of silence, the White Knight hands you a handkerchief and disappears into the mist.
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_BOOJUM_EVENT.title: Boojum
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_BOOJUM_EVENT.pages.INIT:
The pages you have gathered suddenly lose their weight. Names, figures, and courses peel from the paper and fall into the shapeless blank ahead.

Something waits to be named.
[red]Warning: Fighting Boojum may erase some of your saved run history.[/red]
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_BOOJUM_EVENT.pages.FLEE: You turn and flee. The words vanish from the page one by one, leaving a sheet that can never be read again.
BS_ANCIENT_MONSTER_BOOJUM.selectionScree: Preserve a card from the memories.
BS_ANCIENT_EVENT_BALATRO_TRAINING_DUMMY_: A battleworn dummy waits behind a card table. It bears no weapon. Instead, it pushes a pristine deck toward you.
Score [red]300[/red] within 3 turns. Reward: a random Potion.
Score [red]600[/red] within 3 turns. Reward: upgrade 2 random cards.
Score [red]900[/red] within 3 turns. Reward: a random Relic.
The final card falls, yet the dummy remains standing. It silently withdraws the table.
The scoring hand topples the dummy. A moment later, it rises and presents your reward.
Choose 1 to 5 suited cards to play.
Choose 1 to 5 suited cards to discard.
